metadata.chapter: Chapter 94 - STREETS, SIDEWALKS AND CERTAIN OTHER PUBLIC PLACES

content.title: Chapter 94 - STREETS, SIDEWALKS AND CERTAIN OTHER PUBLIC PLACES — Sec. 94-92. - Violations.
content.summary:
It shall be unlawful for any owner or occupant of any building, after being notified
               by the city clerk that the numbers for houses are on record in the office of the city
               clerk, to, for 30 days thereafter, neglect or refuse to number the building or house
              …

faqs.a:
It shall be unlawful for any owner or occupant of any building, after being notified
               by the city clerk that the numbers for houses are on record in the office of the city
               clerk, to, for 30 days thereafter, neglect or refuse to number the building or house
               owned by him in conformity to the provisions of this article.
(Code 1960, § 21-13; Code 1981, § 30-102)
